name: log_errors_recent
description: Recent errors from the journal or a log file, grouped by normalized message with counts and first/last time

minutes.description: window in minutes (default 60, max 10080 = 7 days); 0 = whole file when source is file

source.description: auto (default): journalctl, else /var/log/syslog or messages; journal; file = the path given

path.description: log file to scan when source is file (last 2 MB are read)

min_level.description: lowest priority kept: err (default) or warning
